name: Auto-Match Rate
summary: Straight-through auto-match is at 52% vs an 85% target. The headroom is almost entirely in the ML and hierarchy layers and in lower-quality remittance channels (check, email).

drivers.name: Match by waterfall layer
drivers.narrative: Most volume clears on Layer 1–2; ML/hierarchy are under-utilised today.
drivers.rootCause: The ML pattern model is early in training; as it learns Accuray-specific clearing behaviour (split payments, timing), Layer-3 capture rises and lifts auto-match.

drivers.name: Remittance quality by channel
drivers.narrative: Structured channels (EDI, ACH) auto-match far better than check / email.
drivers.rootCause: Lockbox checks and emailed PDFs need OCR/NLP extraction; the Remittance Capture agent closes most of this gap.

drivers.name: Exception mix
drivers.narrative: What is falling out to the exception queue.
drivers.rootCause: Short-pays and missing remittance dominate — both addressable by deduction auto-creation and the follow-up agent.
